system.flavor:
Scout the room ahead before you open the door, set your mind down a corridor and work a latch from there, look over a wall into a courtyard, or reach past a locked gate with your other cards.

Not enough to pass through a closed door or a solid wall.

body.label: Target
body.html: One visible empty space within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Create an intangible viewpoint until the start of your next turn. Perceive from it and use it as the origin of your next Psionics Action, measuring range from it. It cannot cross solid barriers.

surges.html: Move the viewpoint up to 2 units before that next Action.
Ignore ordinary concealment against detected targets within 2 units of the viewpoint.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, when the viewpoint expires you may move 2 units toward its last location without triggering movement Reactions.
